description: Starfighter in the Reşitpaşa group at 41.10191 29.02201, recorded by spottingmode as 2733/4-733. Construction number 683D-6085. The International F-104 Society places 63-12733 near Istanbul University, which matches. Note that a second Turkish F-104 at Hendek also wears the code 4-733 and is a different and unidentified airframe.
